It literally was like if Spring Awakening and Heathers and Little Shop of horrors had this, like, thing. It's teeth. I don't really wanna tell you anything about it because they won't even let you film the curtain call because they don't really wanna avoid, like, all spoilers. I wanna go again. I wanna be the first two rows. Modest is hottest is literally my new favorite song. Literally my new favorite song. I. I love tea. I love tea.
